newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas bolsa halts Corimon trade, awaits notice.
newsitem.headline: Caracas bolsa halts Corimon trade, awaits notice.

text.p: The Caracas bolsa has halted trade in paints company Corimon while it waits for official notice of the company's share conversion scheme, the stock exchange said.

Shareholders agreed Monday night on a plan that would convert preferred B shares into A shares at the rate of 10:13.5. The company said the conversion opened the way for resumed trade in Corimon's American Depository Receipts, halted in February 1996.
Over 13 million B shares traded in Caracas before Tuesday's suspension came into effect at 11.05 local/15.05 GMT. The stock firmed 1.70 bolivars to 21.70.
